The Precedence and aliases section gives workspace precedence over user and .agents precedence over .gemini within each tier; copying does not establish the active skill.
Built-in and extension skills, enable/disable state and activation consent are managed by the host, not this local-copy installer.
No skills relocation override or additional reserved local name is established by the reviewed skills pages; unrelated environment variables are not interpreted.

Creating Agent Skills, Manual creation, provides macOS/Linux and Windows directory examples: https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/creating-skills/ (reviewed 2026-10-16). Native resolver tests are not OS-specific host discovery tests.
Gemini Code Assist IDE, web/cloud experiences, link installation and remote acquisition are separate unverified or excluded capabilities.
Selecting Gemini placement does not prevent other documented readers from seeing shared .agents locations; native .gemini writes remain distinct.
